title: Risk-Based Motor Claim Processing & Operational Path Rules
source_reference: IRDAI Master Circular 2024 + Insurer Risk-Tiered Claims Operating Model (Synthetic V1)
owner: Chief Claims Officer & Enterprise Risk Committee
disclaimer: Reference configuration for synthetic/demo use. Compliance sign-off required prior to production go-live.

LOW.label: Fast-track claims
criteria: Eligible for predefined automated processing and approval limits (auto-limit <= INR 25,000)

MEDIUM.label: Standard claims
MEDIUM.goal: Reduce handler effort and waiting time

HIGH.label: Complex / investigation claims
HIGH.goal: Improve investigative quality, preserve evidence and ensure controlled decisions
criteria: Injury or third-party liability (including multiple vehicles)
Suspected fraud (advisory only — fraud score never auto-rejects)
Significant loss (>= INR 2,50,000, CTL, fire/flood/theft, airbags)
